title: Route Case Matrix — Life, Strife, Repair and Return Under Evidence
purpose: Turn Life/Strife/Repair/Return from symbolic route names into evidence-aware state-transition tests. The matrix compares how the same starting material can branch under different operators, then applies the route grammar cautiously to concrete project and institutional cases.
master_rule: A route is not assigned from appearance, direction or moral intuition. It is supported only when the starting state, operator, transition condition, downstream consequence and falsifier are explicit.

statuses.synthesis: The route mapping is a project interpretation over documented facts.
statuses.candidate: A plausible route test that still lacks enough outcome evidence.
statuses.falsified: The proposed transition failed its stated test.
statuses.unresolved: Evidence does not yet distinguish among routes.

route_contract.prohibition: Never use a route label as a substitute for a person's, group's or institution's factual identity. Strife, Swamp, Garden and similar terms describe proposed relational mechanisms only.

mechanism_contrasts.starting_material: The same consequential piece of information.

routes.transition_test: The information increases orientation or capability while preserving provenance, agency, privacy/proportionality and correction.
The information becomes fuel for a self-reproducing loop whose incentives increasingly depend on continued conflict or exposure.
failure_signs: conflict is not needed to sustain the system

routes.transition_test: Non-publication protects safety, privacy, uncertainty or due process without deleting the record.
failure_signs: withholding becomes permanent concealment without review

mechanism_contrasts.starting_material: The same Ash/residue after rupture, failure or contradiction.

routes.transition_test: Reactivation hardens roles, shrinks exit/correction and makes recurrence necessary to the relation.
failure_signs: the history can remain visible without compulsory reenactment

routes.operator: establish record + distinguish responsibility + redesign boundary/capability
routes.transition_test: The old material remains remembered but the mechanism no longer has to recur.
Past experience produces independent capability or reciprocal value beyond the original rupture.
failure_signs: future capacity depends permanently on the old conflict or center

mechanism_contrasts.starting_material: The same successful growth or expanding capacity.

routes.transition_test: Growth makes other nodes more capable without permanent dependence and eventually returns measurable value to the World.
Growth increasingly requires permanent dependence, enemy production, humiliation or extraction.
failure_signs: benefits and decision capacity genuinely decentralize

mechanism_contrasts.starting_material: The same downward movement on the Axis.

routes.transition_test: Descent increases grounded capacity and future sprouting.
failure_signs: descent only compounds closure or dependency

routes.transition_test: Each cycle reduces agency, provenance, correction or viable exit.
failure_signs: descent opens evidence, exit or future capacity

routes.transition_test: Integrated perspective becomes observable protection, infrastructure, knowledge, repair or nourishment in World conditions.

mechanism_contrasts.lesson: Downward direction alone cannot identify the route.

cases.subject: The Potato of Life repository homepage and House governance
observed_material: Homepage had repeated center/architecture/navigation blocks that competed for hierarchy.
An older governance validator still enforced retired homepage markup after the homepage structure changed.
Recent build waves existed across many files before they were merged into a single crystallization authority.
cases.operator: identify duplication → choose canonical spine → merge commit results into owners → update validators → project canonical data back onto Home
cases.condition_required: The new hierarchy must survive later edits because canonical owners and validators agree, not merely because the current HTML looks cleaner.
evidence_for_transition: Home now uses Potato → House → Rooms → Views as its stable spine.
Project synthesis contains a governed homepage projection.
House governance now validates the current synthesis and homepage teaching structure.
Homepage reads counts, cases, cycles, layer definitions and Axis data from canonical registries.
counterevidence_or_falsifier: Future pages reintroduce a rival master ontology on Home.
Homepage counts or definitions drift from canonical registries.
Validators stop checking the teaching hierarchy or Axis distinctions.
New concepts accumulate as home-only prose with no owner.
world_return_measure: A new reader can identify Center, House, Rooms, planes, Axis, routes and real cases without reading repository governance files.
Changes in canonical registries visibly update Home without duplicative manual edits.
CI detects drift between the homepage and project synthesis.
cases.route_boundary: This is the project's own development history, so route claims concern repository structure rather than a moral judgment about people.

observed_material: The dossier records migration of DKK settlement from Kronos2 to TARGET Services in 2025.
The dossier records payment disruptions in July 2025 and May 2026 and subsequent work to expand offline card contingency for basic purchases.
Average banking-day payment throughput increased from DKK 732 billion in 2024 to DKK 838 billion in 2025.
cases.operator: incident learning + infrastructure migration + contingency redesign
cases.condition_required: A repair interpretation requires evidence that revised arrangements reduce vulnerability or preserve payment capability under comparable disruption.
evidence_for_transition: A concrete contingency capability was expanded after documented disruption.
Infrastructure performance and throughput are tracked publicly.
counterevidence_or_falsifier: Comparable disruptions continue with no improvement in continuity.
The contingency capability cannot be used under the conditions it was designed for.
Observed resilience changes are attributable to unrelated system changes rather than the intervention.
world_return_measure: availability of basic-payment routes during disruption
cases.route_boundary: The documented facts support an adaptation trace; they do not by themselves prove the project's Repair or Garden interpretation.

observed_material: The dossier records FY2026–27 increases in technology and volunteer-support budgets.
The plan explicitly responds to declining referral traffic, bot/scraping load and contributor/audience challenges.
The organization operates inside a decentralized volunteer knowledge movement rather than owning ordinary article decisions.
cases.proposed_transition: observed pressure → threshold/adaptation → generative branch or capture risk
cases.condition_required: A Garden/generative interpretation requires evidence that investment increases volunteer/community capability, correction or resilience rather than only central organizational capacity.
evidence_for_transition: Planned technology and volunteer-support investment increased.
The plan names resilience and reader/contributor pathways as explicit problems.
counterevidence_or_falsifier: Volunteer capability or meaningful participation declines despite greater central spending.
Community governance becomes more dependent on Foundation-controlled capacity.
Traffic/output metrics improve while correction, representation or contributor health deteriorate.
cases.route_boundary: Budget growth is an input, not Fruit. The route remains unresolved until capability and community outcomes are measured.

observed_material: CERN has a durable treaty/governance foundation reproduced through Member States, Council, technical institutions and research collaborations.
Slovenia joined as the 25th Member State in 2025.
The 2026–2030 strategy prioritizes HL-LHC completion and sets a later decision horizon for the FCC-ee proposal.
cases.operator: institutional succession + training + collaboration + strategy revision
cases.condition_required: A successful reproduction interpretation requires competence and scientific/technical capacity to survive personnel turnover and strategic change without depending on a single founder or cohort.
evidence_for_transition: Governance and membership persist across generations.
New Member States and research cohorts can join an existing institutional grammar.
Strategy is revisable through institutional processes.
counterevidence_or_falsifier: Core capability cannot be reproduced without irreplaceable individuals.
Governance cannot revise strategy under changed evidence or constraints.
Training/collaboration stops generating future independent scientific capability.
cases.route_boundary: The dossier supports institutional reproduction; the quality of particular collider choices remains a separate scientific/political evaluation.

observed_material: Reported donor contributions fell from CHF 2.04 billion in 2024 to CHF 1.76 billion in 2025.
The flexible share of contributions rose from 39% to 45%.
Operational outputs moved differently by category rather than following one aggregate trend.
cases.operator: increase flexible allocation + adapt programmes under changing need/access
cases.condition_required: A Garden/repair interpretation requires evidence that greater flexibility actually improves need-responsive allocation, access, continuity or affected-population capability.
evidence_for_transition: Funding composition changed in a direction that increases allocation flexibility.
The organization tracks multiple operational outcomes rather than one headline score.
counterevidence_or_falsifier: Flexible funding does not improve responsiveness or continuity.
Reduced contributions create capability losses that flexibility cannot offset.
Headline outputs hide deterioration in access, accountability or local capacity.
world_return_measure: continuity of protection/assistance under funding stress
local capability rather than permanent dependence
cases.route_boundary: Funding composition is documented; Garden/repair is only a testable project synthesis, not a factual label for the ICRC.

homepage_projection.purpose: Teach that routes are state-transition hypotheses, not symbolic verdicts.
homepage_projection.reader_question: Given the same starting material, what operator changes what it reproduces?

promotion_gate: Named real-world cases must cite source IDs already present in a source-grounded dossier or add new sources first.
The route mapping must be labelled synthesis/candidate unless the underlying route criterion is directly observable.
Every proposed transition needs a counterevidence/falsifier.
Every route must name a World-level return measure or explain why no return is expected.
No route label may be used to essentialize a person, group, institution, religion, nationality or political position.
